title: Determinantal sampling on general spaces: fast approximation via diffusion geometry
abstract: arXiv:2607.06644v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Determinantal point processes (DPPs) have recently emerged as a kernel-based alternative to standard independent sampling for constructing efficient minibatches, coresets, and other compact representations of large-scale datasets. One of the key strengths of DPP based samplers is that they can be deployed over very general spaces, in contrast to more classical sampling methods beyond i.i.d. which tend to be tailored to particular well-structured settings, principally Euclidean spaces. In this work, we establish explicit rate guarantees for determinantal sampling in spaces that extend far beyond known Euclidean setups, focussing on spectral kernels obtained from eigenspaces of naturally associated Markov diffusion operators, including in particular the Laplacian on manifolds and nearest-neighbour type graphs on data point clouds and the discrete Schrodinger operator on large scale networks. translated_title: 一般空间上的行列式采样：基于扩散几何的快速近似
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.06644v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：行列式点过程（DPPs）近来已成为一种基于核的方法，作为标准独立采样的替代方案，用于构建高效的小批量数据、核心集以及大规模数据集的其他紧凑表示。基于DPP的采样器的关键优势之一是它们可以部署在非常一般的空间上，相比之下，独立同分布（i.i.d.）之外的更经典采样方法往往只针对特定的结构良好的设置，主要是欧几里得空间。在这项工作中，我们为远远超出已知欧几里得设置的空间中的行列式采样建立了明确的速率保证，重点关注由自然相关的马尔可夫扩散算子的特征空间所得到的谱核，特别包括流形上的拉普拉斯算子、数据点云上的最近邻类型图，以及大规模网络上的离散薛定谔算子。这特别涵盖了……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文通过马尔可夫扩散算子的谱核，为流形、图和网络等一般空间上的行列式点过程采样建立了明确的速率保证，突破了传统方法仅适用于欧几里得空间的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes explicit rate guarantees for determinantal point process sampling on general spaces—such as manifolds, graphs, and networks—via spectral kernels derived from Markov diffusion operators, extending beyond the traditional Euclidean-only settings.
